admission.justification: The obligation spans the unchanged server read path and the reader target in two files; deep-note and old-address cases pin both ends.

applicability: Every note reachable through the old reader or the old listing, on any master.
conditions: Any confined note opens at any depth through the explorer; the read route is unchanged.
Old kind/repo/master/path addresses open the same note through the new tree.
exclusions: Depth is no longer a reachability boundary; the old depth of four is gone.
Unconfined paths stay refused; reachability never widens confinement.
statement: Every note reachable before stays reachable through the explorer including below the old depth of four, and old reader addresses open the same note.
